title: Sedona City Council tells staff to get Flock out of town - Sedona Red Rock News
summary: Sedona City Council voted unanimously on Sept. 9, 2025 to cancel its Flock Safety contract and remove all 11 installed ALPRs, citing revelations that Flock had allowed federal agencies (CBP) to access data despite Flock's prior assurances to council. The decision followed controversy over the cameras being installed without council direction and internal complaints against Mayor Jablow.

key_quotes.quote: The Sedona City Council made the unanimous decision to cancel its contract with Flock Safety and to remove the currently installed 11 automated license plate readers during its meeting Tuesday, Sept. 9.
A company that tells us on Aug. 13 that there's no data-sharing going on, I swear, and [later] admits that it's been going on, is not a company that we can do business with
We've seen how data from these cameras can be accessed by federal agencies in ways I wasn't aware of and ways that our community is strongly opposed to
